title: Every Morning
subtitle: Love is made visible through ordinary repetition

shot.title: Two cups in morning light
shot.direction: An ordinary kitchen, two cups, and one small handwritten note.
shot.soundDirection: Kettle, rhythmic pen strokes, season changes, gentle paper opening.

illustration.direction: Wide early-morning kitchen. Danny sits naturally at a wooden table and writes a short note, one hand steadying the small card and pencil touching paper. Annie’s plain cup waits opposite his own. Soft window light and ordinary household detail; card has no legible writing.

Annie places one more small card onto a modest stack held together beside the cups, Danny sitting nearby watching with an ordinary affectionate expression. Each card is materially supported by table and hands; no flying-paper explosion or readable words.

shot.title: Opening a later letter
shot.direction: After Danny’s death, she opens a letter at the same window. Do not turn the loss into a surprise effect.
shot.soundDirection: Kettle, rhythmic pen strokes, season changes, gentle paper opening.

illustration.direction: Later, Annie sits alone at the same kitchen window opening and reading a folded letter, hands supporting its edges. Two cups remain on the table and Danny’s chair is empty. Her expression carries grief and a small recognition; warm morning light, no ghost, apparition or surprise-death effect.

beats.caption: I still find you in these words.
